transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I came in because my husband and the people at the warehouse keep acting like I'm crazy. But I know what's really going on. I know they have been watching my moves at work, and they keep changing the pallet counts on me just to keep me from getting that supervisor spot.
Have you ever heard any voices or sounds when there's no one around to make them?

Yeah, I do. Um, sometimes when I'm in the aisle at work, or even just at home folding clothes, I hear this man's voice. It's clear as day. He tells me, "Nicole, check it again." But when I look around, there is nobody anywhere near me.
About how long ago did you first start hearing this voice and noticing these things happening?
Well, I guess... it's been about eight months now. Yeah, the voice and that feeling that people are watching me or changing my stuff, it's been happening for right around eight months.
Over these past eight months, have you had periods where you felt persistently down, depressed, or hopeless?

No, not really. I mean, I get mad about what they're doing to me at work, but I wouldn't say I've been feeling down or hopeless. I'm just trying to do my job and they keep messing with me. But no, no depression.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually energetic, hyper, or like you needed much less sleep than usual?

Yeah, actually. There have been, um, whole weeks where I sleep maybe three hours a night. I'll wake up way before my alarm even goes off for work, and I just feel completely fine. Like I don't even need any more rest to get moving. I just have plenty of energy to go.
Have you heard the voice or felt like you were being watched during times when your energy and sleep were completely back to normal?

Yeah, I have. Um... there was a quieter few weeks a little while back where I was actually sleeping closer to normal. I wasn't racing around as much, just feeling kind of regular. But even during that time, I still heard the voice telling me to check things. And I still knew that my pallet counts were being changed against me, even when my energy was totally fine.
